name: profile-follow-card
title: Profile Follow Card
description: A creator profile card springs in, its parts blur in one after another, then a cursor glides to the button and clicks it, flipping Follow to Following.
useWhen: Showcasing a single creator profile with a click-to-follow payoff as the action beat.
A social-proof or creator-intro scene needs one profile card with a cursor interaction.
You want an offline-safe card (gradient cover, initial avatar) with no image URLs.
avoidWhen: You are showing follower growth or notifications rather than one profile: use followers-overview.
You need a testimonial or quote card: compose a plain card.
A count-up milestone is the point: use milestone-counter-list.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Bio
variables.description: Short bio, two lines at most; a newline breaks the line.
variables.default:
Making small, useful tools for video teams.
Shipping demos faster with ready-made motion.

variables.label: Location
variables.description: Location in the meta row. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Website
variables.description: Link text in the meta row, in the accent colour. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Joined
variables.description: Date text after "Joined". Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Check mark
variables.description: Show a check mark after the name.

variables.label: Tabs
variables.description: Comma-separated tab labels; the first is active.

variables.label: Sample post
variables.description: Text of the post under the tabs.
variables.default: Shipping something new today. Built entirely with a lot of coffee. More soon.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the cover, button, check mark and link.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the card sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
